scope: Each tested GPIO/I2C/SPI MMIO access is an executed LX6 s32i/l32i instruction; host only sets test instruction operands and physical user inputs.

320x480 ST7796 common RGB565 DCS writes produce the exact expected framebuffer pixel; incorrect MOSI/SCLK/DC and simultaneous LCD/SD selection do not write it. Backlight and TCA9554 EX0 reset hide it correctly. RGB666 payloads are rejected rather than decoded as RGB565.
FT6336 single-point bytes and GPIO37 IRQ, BOOT GPIO0 active-low, SYS_OUT GPIO36 active-high; wrong I2C pins/address NACK.

ES8311 control readback, AXP2101 published ID/reference USB/no-cell register scenario, PCF85063 BCD seconds from normalized guest cycles. MCU reboot preserves independently powered codec/RTC state and rebases RTC cycle origin; a new board has initial defaults.
SPI SD CMD0/CMD8 include the required NCR response byte, on GPIO18/23/19 with CS15; wrong MISO cannot read responses. No filesystem mount is claimed.

qualificationChanges: Initial RTC test incorrectly passed 240 million reset-CPU ticks as one second; the reset 40 MHz XTAL scales those ticks to six seconds on the normalized 240 MHz board horizon. Corrected fixture passes 40 million CPU ticks and asserts the resulting board-clock delta.
Initial SD fixture expected R1 before the mandatory NCR byte. Corrected expectations retain the actual SD SPI protocol response; no card-model behavior was weakened.

publicFactoryGate.scope: Constructor exact memory only; original factory boot is independent.

limitations: Common ST7796 RGB565 DCS subset only; unsupported RGB666 and RAMWRC are not modeled. Analog inversion/gamma/colorimetry, display readback and factory cold-start behavior are not qualified.
FT6336 single-contact FT6x36 report only; no two-contact, gesture, precise interrupt pulse timing or physical chip-revision identification.
TCA9554 reset signals are digital and immediate; analog rails and startup delays are not modeled.

AXP2101 uses the existing documented USB/no-cell reference scenario; it does not implement battery fuel gauge, charging, watchdog, MCU power-off or characterize board EFUSE settings. SYS_OUT input does not fabricate a shutdown.
ES8311 control-port only; I2S PCM, PA audio output and microphone capture are not implemented for this board.
SPI SD byte protocol exists; guest FAT32 mounting, DMA throughput and original factory storage use have not been verified.
Native tests require no ROM and are independent register/protocol probes; they do not claim complete original factory boot, real hardware verification or browser output.
